user.title: Connect your Kindle reading history
user.description: Kindle has no public API, so this integration reads the Goodreads account your Kindle syncs to. Enable it on your Kindle under Settings → Your Account → Social Networks → Goodreads, and make sure your Goodreads shelves are public.
